# CANDIDATE: RELAX_FILTER_9_BODY_LOWER_40

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Filter 9 currently requires the candle body to be in the lower 40% of the range for bearish setups. This condition is too restrictive and caused the engine to miss valid entries on near-miss days where the body was slightly above 40% but still showed strong bearish rejection. Removing this sub-clause will capture more qualifying setups without significantly increasing false positives, as the other components of filter 9 (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence) remain stringent.

## Mechanism

Filter 9 is located in `gates.py` as part of the bearish setup evaluation. The current logic includes a check: `body_pct <= 0.4` (body in lower 40%). We will remove this sub-clause entirely, so filter 9 passes if the other conditions (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence) are met, regardless of body position within the range. No other logic changes.
